data_classification: synthetic demonstration only; facility-level aggregates, no patient data

grains.RAW.FEED_DAILY: one row per facility per day (90 days)
grains.RAW.PROFILE_CONFORMANCE: one row per facility (FHIR profile conformance snapshot)
grains.CURATED.ISSUE_SUMMARY: one row per data quality issue type

freshness: MAX(EVENT_DATE) is an observation watermark; requestedAt is not freshness

required_capabilities.core_pipeline: Curated KPIs reconcile to a RAW recomputation (run_core.py checks this on every build)
required_capabilities.incident_risk_model: Snowflake ML CLASSIFICATION of P(interface incident in next 7 days) per facility, evaluated on an out-of-time holdout; operational, not clinical
required_capabilities.forecast_and_anomaly: 14-day network accepted-bundle FORECAST; unmapped code rate ANOMALY_DETECTION (train 75 days, detect last 15)
required_capabilities.search: Cortex Search SEARCH.FEED_SOP_SEARCH over synthetic FHIR feed operations SOPs (one per source type and issue type)
required_capabilities.semantic_analytics: Semantic view APP.HIE_ANALYTICS and Cortex Agent APP.HIE_AGENT using analyst + search tools
required_capabilities.grounded_ai: Agent answers return generated SQL and SOP citations; the action memo uses only KPI, facility, issue-type and risk rows
required_capabilities.quicksight: DIRECT_QUERY dashboard (facilities, daily accepted bundles and issues, interface incidents by facility, incident risk, bundle events loaded) through a read-only Snowflake service user
required_capabilities.quicksight_q: Amazon Q topic over the curated datasets for natural-language questions
required_capabilities.aws_ingestion: S3 PutObject (bundles/) -> SQS event -> Snowpipe AUTO_INGEST into RAW.LIVE_BUNDLES
required_capabilities.notifications: APP.LIVE_BUNDLE_ALERT logs new ALERT events to APP.ALERT_LOG and emails via SYSTEM$SEND_EMAIL; alert and tasks suspended between demos
required_capabilities.orchestration: Task graph APP.TASK_REFRESH_CURATED -> APP.TASK_RESCORE_RISK run on demand (EXECUTE TASK)

aws.memo: Amazon Bedrock Claude Sonnet 4.5 via APP.BEDROCK_GENERATE
